Approval Note R-2247
Findings and Thickness Readings Summary for Equipment R-2247
**Findings (Severity):**
F-01: Insulation cladding damaged and displaced over a 2 m section of the vapour line. *Minor* (OISD-STD-118 CI. 6.2)
F-02: Localised external corrosion observed on shell plate adjacent to support saddle. *Minor* (OISD-STD-116 CI. 7.3)
F-03: Support saddle anchor bolt at south-west location found loose. No structural distress observed. *(Observation, no severity label)*
F-04: Corrosion and section loss exceeding 20% on ladder/platform grating adjacent to manway. *Minor* (OISD-STD-118 CI. 8.4)
F-05: Minor external scaling and paint chalking on head section. No measurable metal loss. *(Observation, no severity label)*
**Thickness Readings with Minimum Required Values:**
CML-01 Shell course 2–180°: Current thickness 19.28 mm (Nominal 20.0 mm), Min Req 12.7 mm – *Acceptable*
CML-02 Top head‑crown: Current thickness 18.05 mm, Min Req 12.7 mm – *Acceptable*
CML-03 Shell course 2–270°: Current thickness 12.32 mm, Min Req 12.7 mm – **Below Minimum**
CML-04 Bottom head‑knuckle: Current thickness 18.47 mm, Min Req 12.7 mm – *Acceptable*
**Recommendations Summary:**
Reinstate cladding and seal joints (F-01).
Remove loose scale, surface prepare to St-3 and re-apply approved coating system during next shutdown (F-02).
Re-torque anchor bolt to specification (F-03).
Replace affected grating sections before next internal inspection (F-04).
Include in routine painting schedule; no immediate action required for F-05.
**Conclusion:** All findings are either minor or require straightforward corrective actions. The thickness reading CML-03 is below the minimum required value and warrants prompt attention to prevent further degradation.

Inspection Date: 03‑02‑2026
